name: North Myrtle Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in North Myrtle Beach?
answer_short: Yes, with limits. In North Myrtle Beach, a permitted, insured golf cart may use secondary streets posted 35 mph or less, in daylight, within 4 miles of its registered address. Carts are not allowed on Kings Highway, US 501, US 17 or other primary roads, or in bike lanes.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Kings Highway?
faq.a: No. The City of Myrtle Beach says golf carts are not allowed on Kings Highway, US 501 or any road posted over 35 mph.

faq.q: Can kids drive golf carts in North Myrtle Beach?
faq.a: No. Only licensed drivers may drive golf carts on public streets.
